title: Elite: Bind the Betrayal Memory Hollow: Boss Threshold
description: Elite: Bind the Betrayal Memory Hollow: Boss Threshold is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through The Thunder-Oath Gate (Ruin Gate with active oath memory). One selected deity from Odin, Freyja, Frigg, Thor enters; this beat spotlights Frigg as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the pre boss step at Betrayal Memory Hollow, using storm bridge and world-root trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Betrayal Memory Hollow and reveals: A damaged inscription showing the Gate can bind gods as well as monsters. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Betrayal Memory Hollow configured as a pre boss space inside storm bridge and world-root trial; source-culture appearance layer: rune-storm bridges, oath-stone courts, Bifrost storm fractures, Yggdrasil root ramps, Valhalla shieldwall ruins; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: rune-iron oath axes, stormsteel wolf-cloak mail, Yggdrasil thunder-root cores, Valkyrie witness counters

objectives.primary: With one selected deity, survive the boss approach in the elite-tuned Betrayal Memory Hollow, secure the last seal, and enter the chamber with the route law understood.
optional: Clear the Betrayal Memory Hollow without the active deity falling below 35% integrity
Exploit or avoid the route rule: raven omen swarms that reveal hidden names
Resolve at least three oath law, storm timing, world-root control, courage under blackwinter pressure decisions before victory
Finish with the boss, elite, shrine, treasure, or hazard node clearly readable for mobile tactical play

victoryConditions: With one selected deity, survive the boss approach in the elite-tuned Betrayal Memory Hollow, secure the last seal, and enter the chamber with the route law understood.
